assets.name: chicken
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone square food illustration for the DELIVERY section of a Chinese food app, part of a coherent warm pixel-art menu collection.
Primary request: A ceramic rice bowl of Chinese Sichuan pepper chicken, recognizable golden chicken bites and red dried chili peppers over white rice, on a warm wooden tabletop.
Style/medium: genuine hand-crafted medium-grain pixel art. Logical pixel canvas about 128–160 pixels across, then visually enlarged with integer nearest-neighbor crisp square blocks. Deliberate square pixel clusters, stair-step edges, restrained dithering, readable appetizing food forms. Not an extremely low-detail 8x8 icon.
Palette: limited 24–32 colors, warm cream, peach, butter yellow, warm brown outlines; muted sage and pale lavender accents. Keep dish-specific recognizable colors.
Composition: single simple food-and-tabletop scene, slight overhead three-quarter perspective, primary dish centered, entire main plate/bowl/glass and its edges fully visible with generous surrounding margin for cover crop. No collage.
Lighting: cozy natural window light interpreted solely through pixel-art color clusters and hard pixel shadows.
Constraints: no photography, no smooth realistic textures, no blur, no antialiasing, no painterly brush strokes, no vector-smooth lines, no text, no logos, no watermark, no people, no hands.
